decisions.quote:
Analyst success criteria: That all criteria meet Precise Reproduction Criteria.
Reproduction outcome: Based on these criteria, the claim did not reproduce.
Discussion: It’s the sample size that differs but it seems like a typo (0 and 7 are switched).
decisions.reason: The reproduction evaluates 36 claims from Antràs & Chor (2013) against explicit Primary Reproduction Criteria (sample size and focal coefficient). While 35 of the 36 claims met the Precise Reproduction Criteria and reproduced, Claim qxpp39 (Table III, column 7) failed to reproduce the reported sample size (obtaining N = 207991 instead of the reported N = 270991, which falls in the analyst's Non-reproduction range of 230342 > N > 311640) and was explicitly judged by the analyst as 'Based on these criteria, the claim did not reproduce,' even though the focal coefficient (-0.115) matched and the analyst noted the sample size discrepancy appears to be a digit-transposition typo in the original paper. Because not all reported numbers were obtained and one tested claim explicitly failed the analyst's reproduction criteria, the shipped coding of 'computational issues' is supported.
